n: FlipTop™ FT2 Series Cable Management System, 1200 Size, Electrical (FT2-1200-ELEC-PTL-AL)
d: FT2-1200-ELEC-PTL-AL FlipTop™ FT2 Series Cable Management System, 1200 Size, Electrical, Pass-Through Lid, Alloy

specs.label: Lid Open
specs.value: (1) Mechanical button; Slide the button to open the lid; ​Cutouts in the lid allow cables to be extended while the lid is closed.

specs.label: Cover
specs.value: Metal, black or alloy finish, mechanically retracting lid, magnetically-attached bezel

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Flush tabletop mount, fastened by 2 swiveling dogs, 1-3/4 in. (44 mm) maximum surface thickness, 4 in. (102 mm) deep x 10 in. (254 mm) wide cutout (template provided)

specs.label: Power Supply (included)
specs.value: Input: 1.5A maximum @ 100-240VAC, 50/60 Hz; Output: 2.5A @ 24VDC; Model: FT2A-UTK-PWS; NOTE: A single USB rapid charging module is supported using the included power supply.

specs.label: Power Supply
specs.value: Attaches to the left, right, or front side of the FlipTop chassis beneath the table
